Our mission

More than headlines. Context that holds up.

Starter Site is a general news platform created for readers who want to understand what is happening without wading through unnecessary noise - timely stories, emerging trends, and developments that affect everyday life.

“

A headline may capture attention. It rarely tells the whole story.

01 / Accuracy
Accuracy ahead of speed

Every factual claim should be verifiable. We distinguish established facts from commentary, avoid presenting speculation as certainty, and correct material errors when identified.

02 / Clarity
Written for real people

Our articles are written for readers, not industry insiders. We avoid unnecessary jargon and present information in a straightforward way.

03 / Context
Meaningful context

Readers deserve content that explains key details and makes complicated topics easier to follow. Reporting, analysis, and opinion stay visibly distinct.

Editorial Team
Reporting, editing, and standards
How we work

Editorial standards

The Starter Site StandardFive rules we do not break

AccuracyEvery factual claim should be verifiable, supported by named sources or public records. Errors discovered after publication are corrected on the record.

AttributionQuoted persons are identified by name and role. Studies, records, and other reporting are credited and linked. Anonymity is never granted retroactively.

FairnessPeople and organizations covered receive a meaningful opportunity to respond before publication. Where the facts are clear, we report them regardless of preference.

IndependenceEditorial coverage is not influenced by advertising or sponsorship. Sponsors do not review, approve, or modify reporting before publication.

LabelingNews is presented straight, analysis interprets it, and opinion reflects its writer. The three are tagged distinctly and visibly distinguishable at a glance.

Signed — the editors of Starter Site
